# Middleton Services Group LTD

> Independent advisory firm for complex, high-value transactions. Slogan: "Making the Markets Accessible." Offices in Miami, FL 33166 (United States) and Panama City, Panama; operating globally. Website: https://msgltd.net (English: /en, Español: /es)

Middleton Services Group helps owners bring exceptional assets to market, connects capital with opportunity, and acts as a neutral facilitator when a transaction needs a steady hand. The firm is not a marketplace or a fund — it solves complex deals on a mandate-by-mandate basis.

## What we handle

- Aviation (AVN): aircraft acquisition and disposal — valuation, positioning, counterparties, closing
- Maritime (MRT): commercial vessels and private yachts
- Premium Real Estate (RES): discreet transactions for estates and landmark properties
- Gold & Precious Metals (CMD): bullion transactions with verified counterparties and compliance-first procedure
- Oil & Energy (ENR): crude, refined products, and energy assets
- Digital Assets (DGA): regulated digital assets with verified counterparties, sound custody, and clean settlement
- Business Advisory (ADV): structures and introductions for deals that don't fit any category
